parrafo_1.es: Flare Lashes & Brow Lounge es el estudio privado de Camellia, lash artista certificada, en North Sherman Circle, Miramar, FL. Cada cita es individual: pestañas clásicas, híbridas y de volumen, desde un look natural de diario hasta los sets estilo strip-lash wispy por los que se conoce el estudio, además de los faciales Detox Ritual y Smooth Me Out.
parrafo_1.en: Flare Lashes & Brow Lounge is run by Camellia, a certified lash artist, out of a private studio on North Sherman Circle in Miramar, FL. Every appointment is one-on-one: classic, hybrid and volume lash extensions, from a natural everyday look to the wispy, strip-lash-inspired sets the studio is known for, plus the Detox Ritual and Smooth Me Out facials.

parrafo_2.es: Las clientas repiten lo mismo en Fresha: una silla relajante, resultados naturales y pestañas que duran. Flare es un estudio de mujer, de dueña afrodescendiente, que trabaja solo con productos veganos. 5.0 de calificación en 201 reseñas en Fresha.
parrafo_2.en: Clients keep saying the same thing on Fresha: a relaxing chair, natural-looking results and lashes that hold up. Flare is a woman-owned, Black-owned studio that works only with vegan lash products. A 5.0 rating across 201 reviews on Fresha.
